story:
On a warm spring day, the first pink cherry blossoms were collected and then infused for a generous amount of time. Then this essence was used to create Cherry Blossom Cookie.

Just by looking at her, you will feel splendid and warm inside, with a tingle on both your cheeks. On a perfect day, you can see her humming, trying to fly into the air with her umbrella open.

She is most adorable when she offers you delicious sandwiches and tea. But watch out, once she starts to chat, you will lose track of time!

costumes.info: Ancient legends claim a Cookie lives in the solitude of the mountains, surrounded by groves of cherry blossoms and flowers of the deepest crimson. When travelers stumble onto this secluded garden, the cherry blossoms gracefully fall and scarlet petals flutter into the air as if on cue! Some say that there is no escape from such a spectacle. Others who seek this grove would say something too, but they've yet to return...

costumes.info: Pink Candy headphones, a Hologram Jelly umbrella, and with a hip bag as a finishing touch to a sporty look! Cherry Blossom Cookie has emerged as a rising star for street fashion on social media. This peculiar path is said to have been started by the Cookie spilling tea on her usual clothes, but it ended up becoming a very popular style! The crop top is even waterproof, so there isn't even a need to worry about more tea spilling!
